description: This file defines the EditNotebookDialog class, which is a dialog component for editing or creating notebooks within an Android application. It handles user input for notebook names, checks for existing notebooks by name, and communicates with a ViewModel to update or insert notebooks.

classes.name: EditNotebookDialog
classes.description: A dialog for editing or creating notebooks, interacting with the NotebookDialogViewModel to persist changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog with a Notebook object retrieved from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the dialog and returns a binding object.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the dialog's UI and behavior based on whether a notebook object is initialized or not, including setting button actions for saving notebooks.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Companion method to instantiate and initialize EditNotebookDialog with an optional Notebook argument.
